source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Its **transport capacity** is 45 models, all **ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY**, plus 2 **DREADNOUGHT** models. Some models fill more than 1 space:

- **JUMP PACK**, **GRAVIS** and **TERMINATOR** models: 2 each
- **CENTURION** models: 3 each
- **DREADNOUGHT** models: as many as their **W** characteristic

The text lists the 2 **DREADNOUGHT** models beside the 45 yet also gives them a space cost, so whether they count against the 45 is open.

openQuestions: The 2 DREADNOUGHT models are listed in addition to the 45 ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY models, yet each is also given a space cost equal to its W characteristic; the text does not settle whether DREADNOUGHT models count against the 45.
